title: Final Demo Polishings!: More Auroras, differing Sunsets, Moon/Sun cycles working with weather better, and more!
author: fapfap_ahh
selftext:
As we come near the final demo(s) before going onto the full game, I've been doing final polishing and tuning on: the sky, moon/sun, and weather interactions.

Sun and Moon are a bit more prominent and interact with the clouds + lighting the ground objects. A heavy storm or blizzard will completely cover it but you can still see the glow behind the clouds.

Sunsets have more ambience with deep colored skies.

Auroras have gone from just being green and on the North side to multiple colors and all around, guaranteed to show you all colors during a full deployment tour (7 days at the winter forest base). Full game will have them as well alongside other deployment tour locations.

They also reflect onto proper surfaces as needed (water, station exterior, etc).

Side Notes: 

* Please do forgive the video quality, I had to compress it quite a bit from 4K to fit on Reddit.  
* What you see pop up in top left is my dev console. It's part of my built AI gamekit that allows me to trigger whatever I need to in the game for testing (and this video I am showing), plus the AI uses it itself during its own visual playtests or GPU renders.
